transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi... it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm not bothering you with all this. 

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, there's been a lot of tension lately. I don't want to complain about my family and my friends, because I really don't want to sound like a bad person, but... they keep showing me these bank papers and saying they prove that nothing was taken from me. 

But... I mean, for over a year now, I've just known that they're hiding my money. They try to cover it up by talking about paying regular bills, or doing these fundraisers, or making trip plans. I really don't like arguing with them, I hate it actually, but I just have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth. 

I mean, anyone would want the truth, right? I just want to get it all sorted out... I hope that's an okay thing to talk to you about.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

Oh... no. No, I haven't heard anything like that. I promise. I... I only hear people talking when they're actually right there in the room with me. 

I really hope you don't think I'm... you know, crazy or anything, for being here. I just know about the money because of how they act, not because of any voices in my head. Is... is it okay that I answered it like that? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, excited, or full of energy for days at a time?

Oh, um... no. No, I don't think so. I mean, I have normal days where I feel good, like anyone else, but... not like what you're describing. I don't get all wound up or anything like that. 

I try to keep pretty calm most of the time. I don't want to cause a fuss or be too much for people to handle. I just... I just want my family to be honest with me, you know? But I'm definitely not running around full of energy for days. I hope that's the right kind of answer... I just want to be helpful.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or brain condition?

Oh, um... no. No, I haven't. No doctor has ever told me I have a brain condition or... or any serious medical problems. I promise I'm really healthy. 

I try hard to take good care of myself so I'm not a burden on anyone, you know? I haven't had to go to a clinic or a hospital for anything like that... um, is that what you meant? I hope it's okay that I don't have anything to report for that. I just really want to make sure I'm doing this right and giving you what you need.
Do you ever feel that other people can hear or know your thoughts, even when you haven’t said them out loud?

Oh... no. No, I definitely don't feel like that. My thoughts are just... just mine, you know? Kept right up here in my own head. Nobody can hear them unless I actually say them out loud. 

I mean, my family tries to hide what they're doing with the money, but they certainly can't read my mind or anything like that. I really hope it's okay to say no to that one. I don't want you to think I'm holding anything back from you or trying to be difficult... I'm trying really hard to be a good patient and tell you the truth. Did I explain that okay for your notes?
Has anyone told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another in a way that doesn’t make sense to them?

Oh, goodness, no. No one's ever said anything like that to me. I try very hard to be clear when I speak, so people can understand me. 

I mean, sometimes I might get a little flustered if I'm trying to explain about... well, about the money and what they're doing, but I always make sure I'm making sense. I don't want to confuse anyone or make them think I'm, you know, not thinking straight. I try to be very careful with my words. Is that what you were looking for? I hope I'm making sense right now... I really want to make sure I'm being helpful.
Has this belief that your family is hiding your money been present most of the time for more than three months?

Oh... um, yes. I hope it doesn't make me sound bad, like I'm holding a grudge or being difficult, because I really try not to complain. I don't want to be a bother to anyone. 

But... well, yes, it's been a lot longer than three months. It started right after my income dropped... which was about a year and two months ago. I try to just keep my head down and be quiet about it so I don't upset my family, but I promised I'd be honest with you today. Is it okay that it's been going on for that long? I hope I'm answering your questions the right way for your notes.
Have you lost interest in seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?

Oh, no... no, not at all. I still really enjoy things, I promise. I try to keep busy and stay positive, you know? I wouldn't want anyone to think I'm just sitting around moping or being lazy. 

I still like to do my usual things... even if I have to be a little more careful with what I spend, because of the situation with the money. But I still like seeing people, when they want to see me. I try very hard to be good company and not let things get me down. I don't want to be a burden on anyone's mood. I hope that's a good answer? I'm really trying to make sure I'm doing everything right for you.
Did this start soon after a very stressful event in your life?

Oh... um, no, I don't think so. I mean, besides my income dropping like I mentioned before, which was... well, a little hard, but I really try not to make a big fuss about it. Other than that, no, there wasn't any big, terrible event or anything. 

I've always just tried to live a quiet life, you know? I hope it's okay that I don't have a better answer for you... I'm trying my very best to think back, but nothing else comes to mind. Is it alright if nothing else happened? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information for your notes.
Do you believe your family is hiding your money in a way that is realistically possible, or in a way that would require something impossible or supernatural?

Oh... um, no, nothing like magic or anything impossible like that. I really hope I don't sound crazy saying this, because I know how it sounds... but it's very realistic. That's why I'm so sure about it. 

I actually came in today because... well, my family and friends keep showing me these bank papers, and they say the papers prove nothing was taken. I try so hard to believe them, I really do, because I don't want to cause trouble. But... I've known for over a year now that they're hiding it. 

They use normal things to cover it up, you see? Like... like household bills, or saying they're doing fundraisers, or planning trips. It's all very ordinary things, which makes it so hard to explain without sounding like I'm just being difficult. I really hate having to confront them about it... it makes me feel so bad to upset them. But I have to keep asking until they just tell me the truth. I hope you don't think poorly of me for not just letting it go. Do you think it's okay that I keep asking them, since it's my money? I just want to handle this the right way.
